subject: co-dominant and dominant marker in f2-intercross

messages.author: 9458aad4ef91b26a
messages.subject: co-dominant and dominant marker in f2-intercross
parts:
Hello everybody,
I've performed a single marker regression on an f2-intercross
population genotyped with co-dominant and dominant markers. I was
wondering that I've got only QTL at co-dominant loci.
How should I code the dominant markers, because AC and BD coding
presumably doesen't work in R/qtl?
Best wishes
Christof

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] co-dominant and dominant marker in f2-intercross
parts:
I'm not sure what you mean by "AC and BD coding".

For an F2 intercross between inbred lines A and B, we distinguish 5
possible marker genotypes: AA, AB, BB, "not BB" and "not AA".
You can use whatever codes you want for these, as long as you are
consistent. The default is A/H/B/D/C.

See the help file for read.cross, available online at

http://www.rqtl.org/manual/html/read.cross.html

karl
